plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan aims for low, steady returns around 1.5% per month with minimal drawdowns. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged ETFs and high-beta tech, focusing on stability.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to small positions.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly returns with a focus on risk management. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding promising new names from the scanner.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to shift focus to growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly returns but comes with significantly higher potential drawdowns due to increased leverage and concentration. Leveraged ETFs decay daily, and strict stop discipline is crucial to manage risk.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets around 1% monthly returns through distributions, prioritizing low drawdowns. It shifts away from growth and leverage towards income-generating assets and broad market stability.
